rows.note: This is the all-purpose choice for reducing an amount or making something less.

example.english: The government hopes to lessen the amount of rubbish.
example.jyutping: zing3 fu2 hei1 mong6 gaam2 siu2 laap6 saap3

rows.note: Use this specifically for lessening a burden, pain, severity, or punishment.

example.english: The painkillers helped lessen my headache.
example.traditional: 食咗止痛藥，個頭痛減輕咗。
example.jyutping: sik6 zo2 zi2 tung3 joek6 go3 tau4 tung3 gaam2 hing1 zo2

rows.note: Use this casual expression when something has itself become less, rather than when someone actively reduces it.

example.english: All this recent rain has made the number of people on the streets lessen.
example.traditional: 呢排落雨，街上嘅人少咗。
example.jyutping: ni1 paai4 lok6 jyu5 gaai1 soeng6 ge3 jan4 siu2 zo2
